description: This file defines the FilterFactory class responsible for creating and caching filter objects used in the connector framework of SuiteCRM. It manages dynamic loading of filter classes, handling default and override filters, and interacts with other classes like ConnectorFactory.

classes.name: FilterFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and caching filter objects based on source and filter names within the SuiteCRM connector framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing filter object based on source and filter names, loading necessary class files and handling overrides.
